Later source refactors preserved the 0..* cardinality in source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists codesystem=CodeSystem as an active resource. Related Jira FHIR-15103 later resolved no-change because CodeSystem.identifier had already been updated. Later applied Jira FHIR-48689 intentionally removed the old V3-II identifier comment from CodeSystem.identifier because the existing note was sufficient, and that issue is already represented on the combined branch by commit 68a5fe6ae1e93083f456aa175004c4e8bcc72c63.
